# Highlights Morocco Tours

> Highlights Morocco Tours is a private tour operator based in Marrakech, Morocco. It organises tailor-made private tours and day trips across the country with a private driver and a local guide who speaks English or Spanish. Specialities: Merzouga desert tours from Marrakech (2, 3 and 4 days), Sahara camel trekking and desert camps, imperial cities, and day trips from Marrakech, Fes, Ouarzazate and Merzouga. Quotes are free and without obligation.

Website: https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/
Email: highlightsmoroccotours@gmail.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +212 668 561 321
Base: Marrakech, Morocco
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1cDBme3pjB/
Languages: guides speak English and Spanish. The website is available in English, Spanish (https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/es/), Portuguese (https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/pt/) and Italian (https://www.highlightsmoroccotours.com/it/); every page has the same path under each language prefix.

## Key facts

- Highlights Morocco Tours has been organising tours in Morocco for more than 8 years. It was founded by Moha, from the Moroccan desert, who started it to help travellers enjoy their holidays.
- The guides are Moha, Hassan, Rachid and Brahim: all Amazigh (Berber), living in the desert. Each speaks one, two or three languages.
- Tours are private, not shared: a private driver and a local guide, planned around the traveller's dates and pace.
- Multi-day tours start from Marrakech, Casablanca, Fes, Rabat, Tangier and Errachidia.
- Day trips start from Marrakech, Fes, Ouarzazate and Merzouga.
- Merzouga desert tours from Marrakech last 2, 3 or 4 days and include a night in a Sahara desert camp.
- Prices per person, from: 3-day Marrakech to Fes tour 249 EUR; 3-day honeymoon tour 249 EUR; 4-day Marrakech to Merzouga tour 319 EUR; 4-day honeymoon tour 319 EUR; 5-day Marrakech to Merzouga tour 349 EUR; 10-day Morocco tours 649 EUR; 8-day desert tour from Casablanca 749 EUR; 14-day tour from Casablanca 1,190 EUR. Quad rides in Merzouga from 50 EUR (1 person) or 60 EUR (2 people); buggy rides from 120 EUR. Other tours and activities are quoted on request. Final prices are confirmed in a free quote, with no obligation, through the contact form, email or WhatsApp.
